Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a fundamental logical error in the very first step of the conversation. After gathering the birth years (Erich von Stroheim born in 1885 and Mario Missiroli born in 1934), the Planner concluded that "Erich von Stroheim is the younger director." This is incorrect; a person born in 1885 is older than a person born in 1934. The Planner failed to perform the basic arithmetic comparison (1934 > 1885 implies Missiroli is younger, or 1885 < 1935 implies Stroheim is older) and inverted the relationship between birth year and age.
